observations: The page number «12» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01, L05, L09 and L19: the headings of chapters 11-14, in bold, centred; the heading of chapter 13 has no note. No folios of the manuscripts are printed in the margins of this page.
L14: «elmukaam eltheni», the second station (al-maqām al-thānī), in italics. L06 «Notabitur» and L11 «Per» begin with a capital after the colon.
The colons of L06 and L11 and the semicolons of L22 and L24 stand after the thin space of the edition (10-11 px measured). N11: «tendit O —», without a point after the siglum before the dash.
L24: the first word, «ab», is set with its two letters 6 px apart, in a line set wide (word spaces 37-42 px); transcribed «ab».
